WorldObjectDef.label: automated listening post
WorldObjectDef.description: A self-contained, unmanned early-warning radar relay powered by high-capacity solar battery banks. Sweeps the surrounding sector across 12 planetary traversal rings, transmitting real-time tracking telemetry directly to the colony's planetary geoscape grid. Consumes zero local colony TPS.

WorldObjectDef.label: signal beacon
WorldObjectDef.description: An unmanned timber or stone signal beacon established on the planetary surface. Signal bonfires and optical markers observe the sector across 6 traversal rings. Elevated high ground grants organic vantage range bonuses. Consumes zero local colony TPS.
